name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: At the Tower of Althalaxx, the Cult of the Dark Strand's hold has been broken. Word of the victory travels south to Delgren the Purifier in Ashenvale, closing the campaign against the cult in Darkshore.

sections.title: A Threat Severed
sections.body: For weeks, the Tower of Althalaxx was a festering wound in northern Darkshore, held by the fanatical Cult of the Dark Strand and its shadowy masters. Tracking, gathered intelligence, and violent skirmishes dismantled the cult's operations. Its sorcerers are slain and its dark rituals broken, ending the immediate danger of demonic infiltration in Darkshore.

sections.title: Report to Maestra's Post
sections.body: After the cult leader's death, Balthule Shadowstrike sends you south to Maestra's Post, beneath the Ashenvale canopy. Delgren the Purifier waits there, a devoted warrior of the Holy Light who oversaw the fight against Althalaxx's wicked occupants. Your report of the cult's collapse brings peace of mind to the regional defenders, and Delgren gives you his lasting blessing and gratitude.

faq.q: What is the goal of this quest?
faq.answer: You travel from the Tower of Althalaxx's vicinity to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale and report your victory to Delgren the Purifier. This is the final report in the long campaign against the tower's cult.

Delgren the Purifier is an Alliance champion stationed at Maestra's Post in northern Ashenvale. He wields the Holy Light and is devoted to purging corruption and fighting demonic threats such as the Cult of the Dark Strand across northern Kalimdor.

Balthule Shadowstrike is an Alliance operative near the Tower of Althalaxx in Darkshore. He works with Delgren, watches the cult's movements, and guides adventurers as they dismantle the cabal from within.

faq.q: What was the Cult of the Dark Strand doing at the tower?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand occupied the ancient ruins of the Tower of Althalaxx to perform dark rituals, summon demonic entities, and spread its influence across Darkshore's coastal lands.
Maestra's Post is an Alliance outpost in northwestern Ashenvale, just south of the Darkshore border crossing along the main road.

faq.q: Is the Cult of the Dark Strand completely destroyed?
faq.answer: The cult's leadership at the Tower of Althalaxx has been executed and its primary ritual broken, but scattered cultists and remnants still haunt isolated corners of Kalimdor. Its organized threat in Darkshore has been shattered.

angles.text: Reporting to Delgren the Purifier carries special meaning for you as a paladin, since you share his holy mission to cleanse the world of demonic corruption and wicked cults.
The cult's defeat protects the overland road connecting Darkshore and Ashenvale, keeping Alliance scouts and travelers safe from demonic ambushes.
As a night elf, you see the cleansing of the Tower of Althalaxx remove a foul blight from the ancient Highborne ruins scattered through your sacred coastal forests.
